data.subjects: not published per sequence by the dataset authors (subject-level split impossible)
data.augmentation: horizontal mirror (x -> -x on mid-hip-centred coords + left/right joint swap), training partition only, one mirrored copy per training window (x2)

best_model.name: stgcn
best_model.rule: highest mean validation F1 on the fixed split

bench.best_model_rule: highest mean validation F1 on the fixed split (learned models)

pose.gpu: no GPU on this machine: not measured

cv_bullets.bullet_1: Compared LSTM against baselines (rule-based, GRU, LSTM+attention, 1D-CNN/TCN, ST-GCN) on UR-Fall (cam0), 70 videos / 1193 labelled evaluation windows under a video-level split; best model (ST-GCN) reaches fall-class recall 0.84 and F1 0.82.
cv_bullets.bullet_1_cv: Compared LSTM against baselines (rule-based, GRU, LSTM+attention, 1D-CNN/TCN, ST-GCN) on UR-Fall (cam0), 70 videos under 5-fold video-level cross-validation; best model (ST-GCN) reaches fall-class recall 0.68 and F1 0.68.
cv_bullets.bullet_2: Measured end-to-end latency of 31.4 ms/frame (31.8 FPS, YOLOv8n-pose + ST-GCN) on Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz (4 vCPU) with a classifier of 62.5 K parameters / 0.27 MB.
cv_bullets.pose_estimator: YOLOv8n-pose (Ultralytics), 2D COCO-17 keypoints (x, y) = 34-d per frame; not MediaPipe 3D
